reviews.title: CVS apologizes for pharmacist who refused to fill transgender woman's prescription
reviews.quote: She said that he "refused to fill one of the prescriptions needed to affirm my identity" and "kept asking, loudly and in front of other CVS staff and customers, why I was given the prescriptions."
reviews.summary: A pharmacist at a Fountain Hills, Arizona CVS refused a trans woman's hormone prescription and questioned her in front of customers. CVS apologized and said he no longer worked there.

reviews.title: Trans Man Says Walgreens Pharmacist Refused to Fill Prescription
reviews.quote: A transgender man in Oakland, California, claims a pharmacist at his local Walgreens refused to refill his prescribed hormone medication due to a religious objection.
reviews.summary: A pharmacist at an Oakland, California Walgreens refused a trans man's hormone refill on religious grounds. The store manager apologized and he got his medication.

reviews.title: Walgreens adopts transgender-inclusive bathroom policy
reviews.quote: Drugstore chain Walgreens has adopted a new companywide policy that permits customers to use store bathrooms that align with their gender identity.
reviews.summary: After a Hollywood, California store refused a trans woman the women's restroom, Walgreens adopted a policy across its 8,000 stores letting customers use the restroom that matches their gender identity.

reviews.title: Walmart rolls back DEI & Pride funding after direct pressure from far-right extremist
reviews.quote: Walmart says it will no longer participate in the Human Rights Campaign’s Corporate Equality Index, will make changes to its diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) policies, and will monitor its marketplace to ensure “inappropriate sexual and/or transgender products” are not marketed to children
reviews.summary: Under pressure from an anti-DEI activist, Walmart left HRC's Corporate Equality Index, began reviewing its Pride funding, and said it would keep "transgender products" from being marketed to children.
